notes.title: Digital soundtrack has arrived!
notes.content:
Gazmatera 2: America's Least Wanted Soundtrack is now in front of you in all his glory!

Contains 17 tracks from the following artists:


Banda Shlogirani Caranphill
Bigoti
Boiljer
Carski Rez
Dag
DK
Enigma
[expand type=spoiler]not the one you thought of, it's AVI Enigma from Albania, 1970-1981[/expand] 
Grafiti
Grof
Hogari
Horkestar
Moscow Dixieland
Shnur
Sloth


Physical release will be available soon (Russia and Turkmenistan only).

notes.title: Big English Update #1 is here!
notes.content:
You want it - we made it!

and, most importantly,
